appDesc.message: Boost volume, tame loud sounds (night mode), merge to mono, and adjust stereo balance for YouTube audio. Not affiliated with YouTube or Google.

popupHint.message: Applies live to the active YouTube tab. You can also toggle the compressor (night mode) from the equalizer icon next to the volume control in the player.

tipBoost.message: Use this when a video is too quiet even at max volume — it goes past YouTube's 100% up to 200%.

tipBalance.message: Re-centers the sound when it leans to one side. Use the left/right buttons for fine adjustments.

tipCompressor.message: Turn this on when loud and quiet parts differ a lot. It tames sudden ad/effect spikes so you can listen comfortably at night.

tipMono.message: Merges the left and right channels into one — handy with a single earbud or when the stereo mix feels off.

compOn.message: Compressor (night mode) is ON — click to turn off

compOff.message: Compressor (night mode) is OFF — click to turn on
